title: Launch devices gallery
logline: The launch-film devices from the Conqueror study, in litt's energetic register: a word that cycles in place (Cycle, m.cycle), a sentence whose ending is deleted and retyped with its proof beside it (Typed, m.retype), and notifications that stack in on a lock screen (NotificationStack, m.stackIn), with a ring gauge (Ring, m.ring) as the third claim's proof, a contribution grid that fills and turns to dots (DotGrid, m.grid), and the pixels transition. Harbor is an invented product. Reference + lint fixture.

scenes.intent: SEO, run by [a word that flips]: the slot cycles three stand-ins and lands on the name, at the end of the line where its spare width is unseen.

elements.note: One display line, left-aligned: lead in the grey, then the Cycle slot.
<Cycle> of w0…w3; tool-0…tool-3 are its words.

scenes.motion: The line types on, then the slot flips on b1, b2, b3 (steep, snap) and holds on Harbor.

scenes.intent: One phrase, one UI: the ending is retyped three times and each claim's proof springs up beside it.

elements.note: Lead in the grey, the typed ending in fg.
<Typed>: the retyped ending; end-caret is its caret.
Card + Stat: demos booked this week, counts to 24.
Card: a Ring that fills to 89 beside a Stat of AI answers citing you, counting to 412.

scenes.motion: Each phrase types on its beat; its card snaps up as the phrase lands and leaves as the phrase is deleted.

scenes.intent: Before and after in one grid: the weeks fill in on a wave, then every square turns into a dot sized by its day.

text.label: Harbor, 26 weeks
text.headline: Now your SEO looks like this.

elements.note: <DotGrid> 26 weeks x 7 days in teal; days-0... are its cells.

scenes.motion: Label and headline wipe on; b1 the cells fill left to right (steep, snap, 0.8s span); b2 the squares become dots on the same wave. Hold.

scenes.intent: The reward: notifications stack in on a lock screen.
scenes.motion: Label and headline wipe on; four notifications drop in, newest on top, the rest stepping down a row.
